_meta.description: OpenConnector source registry for Shillinq. External submission targets are registered here and referenced by slug. Protocol mapping is openconnector-side per ADR-019; shillinq carries only the source reference.

sources.title: Accountant Audit Portal
sources.description: External audit portal for submission of NIVRA-bestand, steekproef, and ledenraadpleging-export by the accountant. One source row per accountant per administration; protocol mapping (SOAP/REST/SFTP) is declared in openconnector. Shillinq references this source by its sourceId when triggering submission from the audit-pack export pages per REQ-REK-002 and ADR-019.
sources.configurationNote: Operators configure the actual endpoint URL and credentials via openconnector's source management UI. Shillinq holds only the sourceId reference; credentials never land in shillinq per ADR-019 principle.
